data.name: Backcountry Hike To Cathedral Lakes
data.description: Ditch the crowds and head into Yosemite’s serene backcountry. This private, guided day hike is your gateway to alpine lakes, granite peaks, and a secret viewpoint perched on the edge of a cliff. Explore an untouched wilderness few tourists ever see!

meeting_point.address: Cathedral Lakes Trailhead, Yosemite, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Packing List:**
• Sun Hat
• Sunglasses
• Water Bottle (2L per person)
• Sunscreen
• Bug spray
• Raincoat
• Warm Layer

**Optional:**
•  Swimsuit
•  Small Towel
•  Cash, to tip your guide!

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, snacks and lunch!*
